title: Collab: drop the y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev fallback from DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS (keep only signal.dash.jxh.io)
description:
USER REPORT (LOW, config/privacy). User tested collab successfully against their own signaling server (wss://signal.dash.jxh.io) and wants it to be the SOLE default — drop the third-party fallback.

CONFIRMED IN CODE:
- packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/signaling.ts:37-40 — DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS currently lists TWO entries:
    ["wss://signal.dash.jxh.io", "wss://y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev"]
  The first is our own Cloudflare Worker (workers/signaling/); the second (y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev) is a third-party public Yjs server kept as a SECONDARY fallback (see the file header comment lines 24-28, 31-36).

RATIONALE (privacy): a y-webrtc signaling server observes the room id (sent plaintext as the pub/sub topic) and connecting peers' IP addresses. With the fly.dev fallback in the default list, every session signals to BOTH servers simultaneously (a peer connects to ALL listed servers), so the third-party server sees room ids + IPs even when our own server is up and working. The user's own server works, so the third-party fallback only adds an external observer with no benefit. Dropping it keeps room metadata on our own infrastructure only.

FIX DIRECTION (NOT applied — code untouched):
- signaling.ts:37-40 — remove the "wss://y-webrtc-eu.fly.dev" entry so DEFAULT_SIGNALING_SERVERS = ["wss://signal.dash.jxh.io"] only.
- Update the surrounding header comment (lines 24-28 "A public Yjs server is kept as a SECONDARY fallback…", and the lines 31-36 export doc-comment "secondary = a public Yjs server for redundancy") to reflect a single-default posture (no third-party fallback by default; users can still add their own via the Share dialog Signaling-server field, which parseSignalingServers/setSignalingServers already supports).
- Check collab/__tests__/signaling.test.ts for any assertion on the default list length / fly.dev entry and update it.
- Note: redundancy is intentionally traded for privacy — a single default means a session cannot signal if signal.dash.jxh.io is down (the Share dialog already surfaces a 'Signaling server unreachable' banner — ShareDialog.tsx ~351). Acceptable per user intent; the field remains user-editable.

Sibling/related: task 1355 (open-relay hardening of the default worker), task 1354 (host URL reflection).
